action:bankworld/core/simulation.execute: The bank world's dispatcher: every bank command a screen runs goes through it, and each command is its own row.
action:bankworld/index.advanceBankWorld: Brings the bank to the game's clock before a bank command runs; time passing is proven through the scheduled rows and the bank commands.
action:bankworld/index.bankSim: Reads the bank world for the command that follows; not a decision.
action:personal.takeHomeAvailable: Reads how much may come home, inside the Take Home action, which is its own row.
action:song-actions.syncMusicTasks: Follows a song change with the work it now needs; the song changes are their own rows.
action:song-actions.syncSongTasks: Follows a song change with the work it now needs; the song changes are their own rows.
action:state.adoptPlace: Makes a chosen place known to the world; the place field that chose it is the row.
action:time.formatDateKey: Formats a date inside a change; not a decision.
scheduled:birthday: A notice: it tells the player their age has changed. Age itself is read from the birth date wherever it matters (casting, licences), never from this event; switched off, nothing else changed (docs/v10/proof/off-birthday.json).
scheduled:edition-deadline-soon: A notice: it tells the player an entry deadline is near. The deadline that closes entries is its own system (edition-deadline), proven separately.
scheduled:screening-reminder: A notice: it tells the player a screening they were invited to is near. Attending is the screening itself and the RSVP, proven separately.
